sections.overview: This large African carnivore is the sole living member of genus Crocuta.
sections.identification: Its spotted coat fades with age; strong forequarters create a sloping back.
sections.habitat: It lives in African savannas and swamps, but not rainforest.
sections.diet: Its prey is mainly hoofed mammals and their young.
sections.behavior: Clans are female-dominated and forage in changing subgroups.
sections.reproduction: Females give birth in dens and move cubs to communal sites.
sections.ecology: The IUCN account notes human conflict and prey decline as pressures.
sections.conservation: It is globally Least Concern, though its population is declining.
